raw_segments.text: The character of the son begins to develop when he hears his mother complaining that
her husband has no place in the government, of which the consequence is that she has no
Further, when she sees her husband not very eager about money, and instead of battling
and railing in the law courts or assembly, taking whatever happens to him quietly, and
when she observes that his thoughts always center in himself while he treats her with
very considerable indifference, she is annoyed and says to her son that his father is only
half a man and far too easygoing, adding all the other complaints about her own ill treatment
which women are so fond of rehearsing.
